review_comments.body:
** Major** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Recover terminal-only text before finishing an incomplete response.** If a capped response has text in `response.output` but sends no text deltas, this branch emits `RUN_FINISHED` without the answer. The `response.completed` branch already recovers text from that same field. Apply that fallback before closing the text message and emitting `RUN_FINISHED`. Add a no-delta incomplete-response case to the tests. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TanStack/ai/500fe98da48dc49c81103bb1e1335ac3f33738df/packages/openai-base/src/adapters/responses-text.ts))
